position_contract: Search starts with the exact scene heading in the actual QTextDocument; that cursor must be the whole matching block.
Choice search starts from the scene cursor and must match the complete choice-heading block.
The next exact scene heading bounds the selected choice; a spill into later scenes is rejected.
All search positions and compared selection boundaries come from Qt cursors; no Python character offset or len conversion is used.
Only explicit 296 manual navigation changes the player reading tab, selection and scroll; existing periodic filter functions are unchanged.
A reader-context zero-delay timer repeats ensureCursorVisible after the outer parent-tab layout. It does not re-apply an old cursor or old token; it uses the reader current cursor.
native_observation_contract: For every one of the 11 unchanged literal source identities, test checks actual player tab, exact selected heading, scene bounds and viewport cursor rectangle after a real click.
Each successful click records body_reading_anchor including Qt selection bounds, scene/next-scene bounds, scroll and viewport geometry.
Final set equality plus exact count still prevents skipping or duplicating a literal admitted identity.
This catches the observed filters-correct/body-still-scene1 gap; a selected combo alone is no longer accepted.
limitations: Static inspection does not establish the new necessary/native run passed; parent owns those actual results.
cursorRect proves the target cursor location is visible, not that all following effects or the entire scene fit in the viewport.
Current scope has 8 separate source choices with short single-line titles. It does not establish arbitrary future/custom title layout behavior.
Matching depends on the current player heading format; future renderer-format changes must keep this method and regression contract aligned.
prior_evidence_scope: Root visual correction explicitly retains the prior narrow 75-check native and intermediate necessary receipts; neither is silently promoted to the new reading-anchor acceptance.

deferred_failure_scope.description: 132 tests, one failure: selected choice cursor bottom367 outside viewport342 after outer-tab layout changed.
